labels.quote: LG Tallahassee Market Square, LLC, a Texas limited liability company (“Landlord”)
Prime Meridian Bank, a Florida banking corporation (“Tenant”)
labels.note: Filer is Prime Meridian Holding Co; the lease names its bank subsidiary as Tenant. Section 1 states 'Guarantor: N/A'.

Ambiguity: the stated rents imply about 14,700 square feet ($294,000 / $20.00 PSF), not 14,727. Rent Commencement Date is 120 days after the Delivery Date, which depends on Landlord's Work and a lot line adjustment (Sections 2(b), 2(d), 4(a)), so commencement, expiration and dated rent steps are not labeled. Minimum Annual Rent is $20.00/$22.00/$24.20 PSF for Lease Years 1-5/6-10/11-15.

value.rent: 110% of the Minimum Annual Rent of the last Lease Year or Renewal Term

labels.quote: to renew the Term of the Lease for four (4) consecutive Five (5) year renewal terms (each a “Renewal Term”)
labels.note: Notice at least 180 days before expiration, recorded as 6 months. Only valid while the original Tenant (or a merger/branch-asset successor) occupies the premises.

labels.value: While Tenant is open and not in default, Landlord will not enter into a new lease in adjacent Landlord- or affiliate-controlled property to a banking institution with a branch; excludes drugstores, convenience, department or grocery stores offering ancillary services, in-store ATMs, and Existing Tenants.
labels.quote: Landlord will not enter into a new lease in any adjacent property controlled by Landlord or an affiliate of Landlord at such time to any person or entity which is a banking institution that includes a branch

labels.value: Any Transfer or sublease requires Landlord's prior written consent, not to be withheld unreasonably; 60 days' notice with Transferee details and a Transfer Fee; Landlord responds within 30 business days.
labels.quote: without the prior written consent of Landlord, which consent shall not be withheld unreasonably by Landlord
